scope: Five remaining T0/T9/T1 audit repairs requested by the user
covered_behaviors: All admitted shared date fields are canonical Vietnam dates; malformed required dates fail before storage
New and legacy timestamp promises coexist without breaking shared snapshots or real inference
Legacy date views do not rewrite encrypted source rows or historical versions
Same-source same-version retries compare all normalized business facts and reject changes atomically
XML/ERP retries compare source-specific payloads after canonical merging
Invoice revisions cannot make accepted receipts precede issue date or inherit another customer
Conflicting revisions remain retained while snapshot fails clearly; ledger history and reversal stay accessible
Writeoffs retain original customer/document scope; ordinary due-date revision remains allowed
Legacy writeoff scope is inferred only from retained unambiguous history; missing or same-day ambiguous scope requires reversal and review
Late-known pre-origin partial receipts exclude affected historical origins without rewriting original features
Partial receipts known at origin reduce the training cash amount to the remaining balance
Model signature includes date normalization; old incompatible artifacts require retraining
collection_note: An initial pytest invocation without the tests/ scope discovered external ERPNext/Odoo fixture tests under data/ and failed for missing frappe/odoo. The final report covers the complete project tests/ suite.
limitations: No actual enterprise model retraining or activation was performed; genuine historical evidence and sufficient valid data are required
Legacy merged-source records without retained per-source payloads require a newer version for unverifiable retries
Daily knowledge resolution cannot infer the order of same-day ambiguous legacy revisions and writeoff decisions
Technical regression only; no new real-domain forecast efficacy or matching-quality claim
